title: Daytona 660 Triple (Apex Spec)
description: Representing Triumph's prowess in the Middleweight Sportbike class, the Triumph Daytona 660 Triple (Apex Spec) is delivers razor-sharp chassis feedback for riders hunting apexes. A 660cc powerplant pumps out 89 HP and 73 Nm of torque, striking an optimal balance between fuel economy and spirited passing power. With a balanced 820mm seat height providing confident footing and natural knee comfort and a comfortable Aggressive Forward Tuck layout, it offers fatigue-free ergonomics whether carving traffic or cruising the open highway.
